Officer's narrative
Officer responded to a rear-end collision on a roadway in Conroe, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped in traffic when the
vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of
Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and Driver 2 confirmed Passenger was present at the scene.
Damage to the rear bumper of Driver 1's vehicle was visible but limited, and the impact appeared to be light. Driver 1
reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and described the injury as severe. The officer noted that the force of the
impact seemed slight compared with the injury reported, and it is not clear whether all of the visible damage resulted
from this collision. Scene photographs confirm vehicle positions and some of the damage, but no independent
witnesses were located. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to the officer or reported by either driver.
Driver 1 is named on the insurance policy covering the vehicle.
